fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $30,000, uniform for all franchisees. A veterans incentive discount reduces the fee to $15,000 for qualified veterans of the United States Armed Forces (applies only to the first Restaurant). The fee is earned upon signing the Franchise Agreement. If franchisee fails to complete initial training, ½ of the fee is refundable upon signing a confidentiality agreement and general release; otherwise non-refundable. A separate $1,000 non-refundable extension fee applies if a one-time extension of the Possession Deadline is requested. An additional $10,000 New Restaurant Marketing Program Fee is due when the premises lease is signed. A Development Fee of $15,000 per additional Restaurant (beyond the first) applies under an Area Development Agreement, credited back against future Initial Franchise Fees.
raw_excerpt: When you sign a Franchise Agreement, you must pay us an initial franchise fee in the amount of $30,000 ("Initial Franchise Fee") . The Initial Franchise Fee is uniform for all franchisees , except for discounts offered for veterans (as described below), and is earned by us when you sign the Franchise Agreement. ... If you qualify, you will pay a reduced Initial Franchise Fee of $15,000 and will sign the Form of Veterans Incentive Program Addendum to the Franchise Agreement, attached as Exhibit G, when you sign your Franchise Agreement.
